notes: Pages opened (1 of 1-2): List of Zhou dynasty states. No separate Wikipedia article was found under the titles tried, so identity.wikipedia is null; Wikidata id left null (unreachable). SOURCE: one table row, read twice (columns: Name of state | Hanzi | Family | Present location | Title | Start and end year | Conqueror). The zheng dossier (ea-01-d) carries the 767 gain with the Zhengzhou 25 km disc, whose centre lies about 28 km east of Xingyang (the disc just misses it). The list also has a Northern Guo ('Early Spring and Autumn Period-655 BCE', Jin, Pinglu County) and the Western Guo (western-guo dossier). The western-guo page's infobox date 687 BC is a Qin conquest of 'Xiao Guo', a different state. The disc and the capital dot are the researcher's reading of the county or town named in the row (coordinates, since the gazetteer lacks most of these places). AREA: none. No rulers, no capitals, no wars on the list.
